description:
Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/orphaned-capability-scan.ts. ONE file only. Make ONE contiguous change.

The scan flags a resolver as orphaned when it is "invoked by 0 of the activity corpus". That surface is too narrow: it counts ACTIVITY-mediated invocation only, so a resolver consumed directly by ANOTHER RESOLVER is invisible. Proven live — solicitation_outcome_scan consumes the uiQuestion read shape on every bare dispatch (it self-supplies ids from it and returns 85 outcomes), yet the scan still emits orphaned-capability-uiQuestion. The detector cannot see a repair that already happened.

This file ALREADY CONTAINS the helper you need, added earlier today: findCandidateConsumers(shape) greps repos/*/src for non-test files referencing a shape and returns up to 8 paths. It is already called inside emitOrphanGap. REUSE IT — do not write a second scanner.

Find the place where a shape is decided to BE an orphan (the test that produces capability_orphan_count and drives emitOrphanGap), and make a shape NON-orphaned when EITHER condition holds:
  (a) it is invoked by the activity corpus — the existing check, unchanged; OR
  (b) findCandidateConsumers(shape).length > 0 — some resolver in the tree already references it.

Do not remove or weaken the existing activity-corpus check. This WIDENS what counts as consumed.

The change must typecheck. VERIFY BY CONSEQUENCE: orphaned-capability-uiQuestion stops being emitted by the scan, and capability_orphan_count falls from its current 33.
